The check ran but did not request this finding's own endpoint, so it proves nothing about it.

findings.retestPanel.help.error.text: The tool could not run this check.
findings.retestPanel.help.excluded_by_po: The finding is unchanged. Verify it by hand or in a planned test window.

findings.retestPanel.help.matched_elsewh: The finding stays open as it is. The reason lists the other paths; consider reporting them as their own finding.
The finding's own endpoint no longer matches, but the check matched at another path of the same target.
findings.retestPanel.help.no_endpoint_pr: The finding is unchanged. Add a retest check pinned to the exact URL of the finding.
The check ran, but nothing shows it requested this finding's endpoint, so a missing match proves nothing.
findings.retestPanel.help.no_verdict.fix: Retest again. If it repeats, check the sensor and the run log, and update the sensor.
findings.retestPanel.help.no_verdict.tex: The tool ended without a verdict for this finding (it stopped early or never reached the target).

A scan sighted the finding again after the check ran, so the check does not show the current state.
